info.name: Task Board API
info.description: Local Task Board API. Start the API at localhost:3000. Run Login first; its test script saves the JWT to the collection token variable. Protected requests inherit Bearer auth.

request.description: Confirm the API process is responding.
Returns a short-lived JWT and user profile. The test script saves the JWT for protected calls.
Revoke the current JWT. Reuse of this token will return 401; run Login again to obtain another token.
Counts tasks by status and returns total story points.
Search by title or description; optional priority/status filtering, safe sorting, pagination (limit max 100).

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Review onboarding flow",
  "description": "Walk through the first-run experience",
  "storyPoints": 3,
  "priority": "Medium",
  "status": "Backlog",
  "plannedDate": "2026-11-09",
  "dueDate": "2026-11-13"
}

request.description: Creates a backlog task. Set status to Planned to enforce daily and weekly capacity.

request.description: Replace task fields or update status. Moving into Planned checks both capacity limits; completed tasks cannot return to Backlog.
Permanently deletes this task (the application asks for confirmation first).
Read the workspace daily and weekly story point limits.
Save positive daily and weekly capacity. Daily must not exceed weekly.
